subject: Tri-party facilitator handshake — pick overlapping time slabs (APAC / EU / US)
messages:
From: Priya Rao <priya.rao@cloudwave.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 16:12:00 +0200
Subject: Tri-party facilitator handshake — APAC/EU/US slabs

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the quick sync last week. Cloudwave, Redwood, and the three marketplace teams (AWS/GCP) are aligned on running a single demo run that covers: 1) Redwood-hosted inference flow, 2) SI integration pattern, and 3) marketplace listing/ops checklist. The ask from the partner side is to lock a set of overlapping time slabs we can use for rehearsals and the live walkthrough so regional teams can join without juggling too many invites.

Proposed high-level windows (all in UTC):
- APAC rehearsal: 01:00–03:00 UTC (friendly for APAC SIs)
- EU overlap: 08:00–10:00 UTC (EU + early US attendees)
- US live window: 16:00–18:00 UTC (primary live demo)

Can Redwood confirm:
- Primary facilitator for each slab (and one fallback)
- Confirmed AV/platform owner (who will manage streaming/recording)
- Any nonnegotiable blackout times from your side (team PTO / product freeze)

I attached a very small draft agenda and a CSV with suggested fallback presenters from Cloudwave's end. Happy to iterate.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Rao | Strategic Partnerships, Cloudwave
Attachments: tri_party_agenda_v1.pdf, fallback_presenter_list.csv
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Rao <priya.rao@cloudwave.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 18:05:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Tri-party facilitator handshake — APAC/EU/US slabs

Priya — thanks for laying this out. This is helpful. Quick answers inline: 

- Primary facilitators (Redwood):
  - APAC rehearsal: Laura Bennett (will lead the infra walkthrough) — fallback: Karthik Iyer
  - EU overlap: Vivek Kulkarni (customer/partner introductions + routing policy talk) — fallback: Laura
  - US live window: Karthik Iyer (end-to-end demo and Q&A) — fallback: Vivek

- AV/platform owner: we'll use Redwood's standard streaming stack (obs + internal relay). Laura will own the recording/stream link.

- Blackouts: there is a company-wide product freeze scheduled 2027-06-21 00:00–06:00 UTC for a prior release train; avoid scheduling rehearsals in that slot. Also, Karthik is OOO 2027-06-20 (back on the 23rd).

Next steps I propose:
1) Laura will post a calendar with three tentative time slabs (she's copying in her proposed slots below).
2) Cloudwave + AWS + GCP confirm who will own the marketplace deployment step (we need a named person for the runbook).
3) We agree on a dry-run date (I'd suggest 2027-06-22 for rehearsal window 1 or 2 depending on region) and a fallback rehearsal the week after.

Sharing the attachments back after a quick pass (minor edits).

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni | Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
